name: Sanders Metal Products Inc
old_description: Custom fabrication isn’t a skill you’re born with—it’s earned with training, hard work, and experience. At Sanders Metal Products, we appreciate the value of great custom metal fabrication more than the average Joe. We’ve been doing it for over 30 years.
about:
Sanders Metal Products operates from Fargo, North Dakota, where it has provided custom metal fabrication for over 30 years. The company’s founding year and original owners are not disclosed in public materials.

The shop offers a full range of metalworking services: welding, metal fabrication and cutting, CNC machining (including vertical milling and turning), plasma cutting, vertical band sawing, painting and lining, and assembly. Equipment includes a CNC 400-amp HD plasma cutter, a VT 120 HA-50 HE&M high-speed vertical band saw, vertical CNC machining centers, and several CNC lathes (Cincinnati and Clausing 2040 models). Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Sanders serves customers who need structural metalwork, industrial equipment components, and artistic metal installations—summarized on its site as “structures standing, equipment working, or artwork hanging.” No specific industry sectors or client names are listed.

The company emphasizes its breadth of in-house capabilities and experienced welders and machinists as differentiators, promoting itself as a “premier custom metal fabrication shop in the Midwest” that handles projects of any scale and welcomes walk-in inquiries.
